title: Error Analysis of Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.23321v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This review examines deep learning theory through the lens of error decomposition, systematically addressing approximation, statistical, and optimization errors. We trace the development of error analyses from bounds on individual error components to frameworks that account for all three. Using nonparametric regression and the Deep Ritz Method as dual running examples, we demonstrate how these analyses apply across fundamentally different loss structures. We then review representative analyses in scientific machine learning, generative learning, reinforcement learning, representation learning, and large language models, showing how learning errors affect solutions, distributions, and predictions through problem-specific arguments. Throughout, we clarify which error components are controlled, how they are combined, and what assumptions are needed to obtain guarantees for trained networks.

translated_abstract: 本文从误差分解的视角审视深度学习理论，系统地探讨逼近误差、统计误差和优化误差三类问题。我们追溯了误差分析的发展历程——从对单个误差分量的上界估计，发展为同时涵盖全部三类误差的统一框架。以非参数回归和Deep Ritz方法作为两个贯穿全文的示例，我们展示了这些分析如何应用于本质上不同的损失结构。随后，我们综述了科学机器学习、生成式学习、强化学习、表示学习和大语言模型领域中的代表性误差分析，通过针对具体问题的论证，展示了学习误差如何影响解、分布和预测。贯穿全文，我们阐明了哪些误差分量得到了控制、它们如何被组合，以及为获得已训练网络的性能保证需要哪些假设。
tldr: 本文以误差分解（逼近、统计与优化误差）为统一视角系统综述深度学习理论，梳理从单个误差分量分析到综合框架的发展脉络，并结合多个应用领域的实例阐明如何获得已训练网络的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This review systematically surveys deep learning theory through error decomposition into approximation, statistical, and optimization errors, tracing the evolution from bounds on individual components to unified frameworks, and illustrating how learning guarantees are established across scientific machine learning, generative learning, reinforcement learning, representation learning, and large language models.
